research_venue.Name: Toilet /before Langelinje
research_venue.Description: A cruising directory refers to a public toilet just before Langelinie near Kastellet in Copenhagen, describing afternoon activity without a date for that claim. Copenhagen municipality confirms two public toilets close to the Kastellet grounds, one at Langelinie and another by Langeliniebro, but it is unclear which one the contributor meant. The direct page's comments stopped in September 2025; a newer 10 June 2026 city feed says one visitor intended to go that evening, which is not evidence of an encounter.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Copenhagen public toilets may have variable schedules or close seasonally. The city states non-24h sites generally close by 19:00 in winter or 21:00 summer, with some closed in winter; individual current site status requires city map check. Do not apply directory's undated 16:00-17:30 popularity claim as opening hours.

research_venue.Name: Zappion Gardens
research_venue.Description: The landscaped grounds around Zappeion Megaron are a long-standing cruising-directory entry in central Athens. The directory points to the fountain south of the main building and nearby planting, but its assertions of constant high traffic and sexual encounters have no date. June 2026 commenters discuss visiting and one describes the men as appealing; a February 2026 firsthand visitor says the park was empty that night. These support some recent onsite attention without proving any particular encounter. The National Garden next door is separately gated and closes at sunset, so do not confuse it with the Zappeion grounds or promise all-night access.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Public landscaped areas used by daytime visitors and event guests. Adjacent National Garden expressly open sunrise to sunset with gates; this should not be applied automatically to Zappeion Park. Event-hall facilities and planted zones require independent permission.

research_venue.Native_Map_Query: Davaki Square Πλατεία Δαβάκη, Athens, Greece
research_venue.Description: Davaki Square (Plateía Daváki) is a municipal square in Kallithea, southwest of central Athens. Its original cruising-directory description concerns a toilet near a main park entrance, but gives no operator-verified restroom layout or hours. A March 2026 country-feed post solicits a meeting but does not report an encounter; the direct listing has only one blank March 2025 comment. Kallithea municipal security contracts and a contractor's record confirm organised late-evening square patrols historically, meaning this should not be presented as an unrestricted private setting.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Active municipal square with visitors, public infrastructure and night security patrols reported in 2021–22 sources (not proof the identical security contract continues in November 2026). Toilet hours unknown, and public restroom use must respect privacy and consent.

research_venue.Name: Limanakia A
research_venue.Description: Limanakia A is the first of a chain of rocky swimming inlets below Poseidonos Avenue between Vouliagmeni and Varkiza. The cruising directory uses 'Limanakia A' for the first bus-stop approach and claims activity on rocky ledges. A December 26, 2025 contributor calls it active by day and late evening—recent anecdotal evidence but an unspecific description rather than a verified firsthand sexual encounter. Limanakia B, around 600 metres away in the same directory, has stronger independent gay-nude-beach recognition. These two shoreline entries should not be merged just because their names are similar.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Steep unmaintained rocky trail from EO91/Poseidonos road with limited facilities, deep water and occasional slippery ledges. Bus stop and road verge access does not imply safe parking or private sexual conduct. Bring adequate water and use daylight routes rather than unlit descent.

research_venue.Name: Calton Hill
research_venue.Description: Calton Hill is a busy central Edinburgh heritage hill with skyline viewpoints and listed monuments. Two specialist directories record it as a cruising area, but the CruisingGays map/data are years old and the archived Squirt listing cannot be opened without access. There is no date-supported recent encounter. On the hill's steep western Greenside slope a conservation group has proposed further nature reserve protection during 2026; that proposal has been considered but should not be described as an already-designated new reserve. The exact alleged cruising section and legal access are unknown.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Public hilltop viewing/heritage grounds with steep paths and protected ecological areas, tourists and monument events. Vehicle gate restrictions are separate from pedestrian access; private monument areas and wooded slopes must not be assumed open for sex meetings.
